title: parliament noises.wav by Eneasz
author: Eneasz
sourceDescription: The sounds of the British Parliament, mainly the House of Commons, as they break into cheers of support, or jeers of derision, or laughter. The speakers have been clipped out so it's just the roar of the crowd. Taken from the following open-to-the-public footage: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QpZhugomNJE http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5xUy2inkGHQ http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zMdsOqGASRE
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -6.60 dBFS); 30 ms fades
